frame.origin: the building's leeward (downwind) wall centre on the ground; x = 0 is the leeward wall
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind blows toward +x); building x in [-0.08, 0]; floor source at x = +0.04 m (0.25 H beyond the leeward wall)
frame.y: +y lateral; building y in [-0.04, 0.04]; the z/H = 0.025 plane is measured on the y <= 0 side only, the z/H = 0.25 plane on both
frame.z: +z up; roof at 0.16; heated floor at z = 0
frame.length_scale: model metres (the sources state no model:full scale ratio); b = 0.08 m, H = 0.16 m
frame.source: 5 mm diameter floor outlet at (0.04, 0, 0); 5 % ethylene in air at 30.4 degC, 9.17e-6 m3/s (readme, data paper section 3.10)

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: generated from the readme's stated dimensions b = 0.08 m, H = 2b = 0.16 m; the building spans x in [-0.08, 0] (leeward wall at the origin), y in [-0.04, 0.04] (MP-y_caseJ.png, MP-z_caseJ.png)
